info.title: CraveCart API — contract baseline
info.description: Endpoint inventory plus critical schemas. GET /platform and the operations exported in identity.openapi.json and catalog.openapi.json and commerce.openapi.json are implementation-ready; remaining operations require contract promotion before client generation. x-contract-status records each operation's lifecycle.
